rows.label: exsanguinate picture: fighter fields
rows.why: The picture's own state on the fighter (the thread's reach, the flush clock, the cast and hp already seen, the side, the snap); never m.ultFx (open item 25). Read by nothing in the sim.

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the presentation call
rows.why: tickPresentation runs through hit stops and after the match; one call to tickSiphon.

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: tickSiphon
rows.why: Finds the cast by drainTally.casts rising (the flush clock) and the drain by drainTally.drained rising (a '+n' float per whole hp, the engine's own Match.float, filed here and never in tickStatus); drives the thread's reach off ultDrain && !over && both alive && the foe bleeding, and files the snap at the close (clock, death or verdict). Writes presentation fields and floats only; shellHash, no rng.

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the thread's call (world, under both balls)
rows.why: World pass under both balls, rim to rim: the thread, its beads and its snap (bloom share 0; nothing inside a shell).

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the flush's call (world, over both fighters)
rows.why: World pass over both fighters: the cast's 0.25s dark-red flush on her shell (a darkening; the foe's shell cut out when she is b).

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the drawing methods
rows.why: drawSiphon / drawSiphonTop and one method a component (path, cord, thread + beads, snap).

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the nova's burst retired
rows.code:
/* ---- EXSANGUINATE'S BURST OF BLADES IS RETIRED WITH THE NOVA (v76; built
       v106): the fang ring, its 300-unit sweep and the threads pulled back
       off the quarry were the nova's. The drain draws off the FIGHTER
       (`drawSiphon`), where the one ultFx slot cannot erase it. */
rows.why: drawUltOver's widowmaker branch was the NOVA's set-piece (14 fangs on a 300-unit ring, the threads pulled back off the quarry); the nova is out (v106 stage 1), so its picture goes too.

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the ultFx life entry retired to the cast's record
rows.code:
/* EXSANGUINATE (v106) IS NO LONGER A SET-PIECE ON THIS SLOT either.
         Its window is drawn off the fighter (`drawSiphon`, `drawSiphonTop`),
         where the one slot cannot erase it; the burst of blades that read
         this record is retired and its field spec is out, so its entry
         below carries the CAST's record and nothing draws from it -- as
         for Daybreak and Corollary. The number is kept: the record's
         lifetime is the cast's, and changing it would move nothing drawn. */
rows.why: The widowmaker entry in the ultFx life map timed the nova's burst; with the burst and its field spec retired nothing draws from the record, so the entry is annotated as the cast's record only (the Daybreak / Corollary precedent). Comment only: the number (1.3) and every byte of behaviour stay.

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the banner's spread
rows.why: The banner's clamp reserved 52 a letter for the fan's horizontal throw; the filling letters have none.

rows.label: exsanguinate picture: the banner's letters fill
rows.why: The banner's letters were thrown out of the nova's fan and dripped off at the end (blood leaving); now each letter's red rises in it from the foot, left to right (a level coming up).

The v76 section 5 stage 3 brief says: "field spec REMOVED (the nova's burst spec is dead) -- both copies, sha re-stamped".                   life: [0.30, 0.75], heavy: 0.05, size: [0.8, 2.2],

Measured reason, from fxprobe.out (123 windows, 16 foes x 2 seeds, both sides):
- The one ultFx slot belongs to Widowmaker for a median 0.58 s of the 8 s window (max 0.62). That is 7.1% of the window clock. The slot is lost to the clock expiring (107), the opponent's cast (13) or the match ending (3).
- Only 6.6% of the drained hp lands while the slot is still hers.
- While the drain pays, the foe is a median 186 units from the burst point (p10 64, p90 383).
So a slot-borne field could show at most the first half-second of a mechanic that lasts 8 s, and in the wrong place. The picture draws its own world-pass art off the fighter instead, which is the Zenith and Canopy precedent.

READINGS DECLARED (the pictures are Code's picks under "you pick i overrule"):
1. THE '+n' is the engine's own Match.float, filed from tickPresentation (tickSiphon), never from tickStatus. It fires once each time drainTally.drained crosses a whole hp, so it follows hurt()'s rounding rule. m.floats is presentation only: it is aged in tickPresentation, drawn, and lerp-snapshotted, and the sim never reads it. Probe [7]'s float clause stays PASS and did not need moving. It is not drawn in the renderer off hp, as the task text suggested. The float cap of 40 can shift out an older float, which is presentation only.
2. PROBE [6]: nothing is set in fireUlt. The flush clock (siphonAge/siphonSeen) starts when tickSiphon sees drainTally.casts rise, in the same step. [6] diffs only across fireUlt, so its list needs no change. If [6] is ever widened to the whole cast step, add siphonAge, siphonSeen and siphonFade: presentation clocks the sim never reads.
3. THE THREAD STOPS AT `over`: open = ultDrain && !over && both alive. A thread still up at the kill (6 of 53 snaps) SNAPS at the verdict for 0.3 s of the presentation clock. That snap is the only thing drawn after `over`, and it ends before the verdict panel. If the task's "gate the drawing on !m.over" is meant strictly, add `&& !this.over` to the snap filing in tickSiphon; that is Rick's call to overrule.
4. PER THE DESIGN, the thread shows only "for as long as the foe bleeds inside the window". A window with an unbleeding foe draws nothing after the cast's flush and banner (watched: t 20-22.6 in W1), and it snaps only if it is up at the close (53 snaps in 76 windows). Rick may want to see this against his "hard to tell what it does" bar.
5. The flush is a darkening (dark-red radial gradient, 0.55 at the centre to 0.82 at the rim) drawn over both fighters. When she is b, the foe's shell is cut out of it. It never brightens a disc.
6. The beads are placed by drainTally.drained, so they move only when a tick pays her, and one enters her shell per whole hp. The thread leaves from the drips' own arc (_stBleed's 0.44..PI-0.44).
7. The banner's letters fill from the foot, left to right, in 0.35 s. Widowmaker's 52 spread entry is removed.
8. The ultFx life entry (1.3) is kept, with a comment only (the Daybreak/Corollary precedent).
9. drawUltOver's Widowmaker branch is replaced by a comment.
10. ULTSIG.widowmaker (482) is KEPT, stage 6's pick: a drop with a ring drawn into it, which already reads as a drain.
11. SFX 'wet slice' (6245) is the VOICE job's row (stage6-voice), not in these rows. The two compose in both orders.
